text.p01: To those who do good quietly, just like Bunny. A story about kindness, humility, and helping others.
text.p03: In a peaceful forest, a little Bunny lived quietly under the trees. He was small and shy, but he loved to help others.
text.p04: One hot day, the forest’s watering hole dried up.
text.p05: The animals were worried. “What will we do?” they cried.
text.p06: Tap-tap! Clink-clank! That night, Bunny found a broken pipe and fixed it.
text.p07: By morning, the water was back. “Who did this?” the animals asked.
text.p08: Bunny stayed quiet, hiding in the grass.
text.p09: Another day, a strong wind blew Mama Bird’s nest to the ground. One egg got lost.
text.p10: That night, when everyone was asleep, Bunny went searching for the missing egg.
text.p11: He found it and carefully, he carried it back to the nest.
text.p12: When Mama Bird saw her eggs safe, she chirped, “Who helped me?”
text.p13: But Bunny just hopped away unseen.
text.p14: In winter, snow covered the forest paths. “What will we do?” squeaked the squirrel.
text.p15: The animals couldn’t find their way to their food.
text.p16: That night, Bunny worked quietly, to clear the path.
text.p18: By morning, the path was clear.
text.p19: “Who cleared the snow?” the animals asked. But they never knew.
text.p20: One day, a squirrel saw Bunny helping.“Why don’t you tell anyone it’s you?” the squirrel asked.
text.p21: Bunny smiled. “Helping is more fun when it’s a secret! It’s not about being noticed. It’s about making someone’s day better.”
text.p22: The animals started wondering about a mysterious “Secret Hero” in the forest. "Who could it be?" they whispered to one another.
text.p23: Inspired by the unseen helper, the monkey cleared water paths.
text.p24: And the birds sang cheerful songs to brighten everyone’s day.
text.p25: The forest soon became a better place full of hidden acts of kindness, where small efforts made a big difference.
